s1.syndrome_frame: persistent unilateral breast swelling with a new subareolar mass
salient_findings: persistent swelling of the left breast for four years
new, mildly tender, firm 1-cm subareolar mass under the left nipple
lobulated retroareolar mass approximately 1.5 cm in diameter on mammography
key_facts: persistent swelling of the left breast for four years
new, mildly tender, firm 1-cm subareolar mass under the left nipple
repeat ultrasonography demonstrates a 1.5-cm long, solid structure with lobular architecture
mammography reveals a lobulated retroareolar mass approximately 1.5 cm in diameter

shortlist.label: Gynecomastia
shortlist.why_kept: History of anabolic-steroid use and initial diagnosis

shortlist.label: Intraductal Papilloma
shortlist.why_kept: New, mildly tender, firm subareolar mass with solid structure on ultrasonography

shortlist.label: Male Breast Cancer
shortlist.why_kept: New, firm subareolar mass and lobulated retroareolar mass on mammography

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Solid structure with lobular architecture on ultrasonography

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of gynecomastia attributed to anabolic-steroid use, and the new mass has a lobular architecture on ultrasonography, which is consistent with gynecomastia, especially given the patient's history and the absence of microcalcifications or other suspicious features on mammography.

rejected.label: Intraductal Papilloma
rejected.why: Typically presents with nipple discharge, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Male Breast Cancer
rejected.why: Would be expected to have more suspicious features on imaging, such as microcalcifications or irregular margins, which are not present.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: More common in women and typically has a distinct border on imaging, which is not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Phyllodes Tumor
rejected.why: Usually presents as a rapidly growing mass, which is not indicated in the vignette, and would be expected to have more concerning features on imaging.
